findings.evidence: Chebotarev/README.md lines 581–606 orders Layer 12.5's `ψ_C(x)/x` limit before Layer 13 and says Layer 13 consumes the existing generic transfers; Suggested.lean lines 542–560 has the same order. `rg` finds `tendsto_frobeniusPsi`, `tendsto_frobeniusTheta`, and `tendsto_frobeniusPrimeCount` only in the roadmap, while the generic transfers already occur in ArithmeticDirichletSeries/Prime/Psi.lean:303 and Transfer.lean:152.
findings.fix: Land Layer 12.5 separately (or identify an open PR providing it), then rebase this focused Layer 13 work and state the roadmap endpoint using that theorem.
findings.issue: The new conditional transfer package and `Count.lean` build Layer 13 before the required Layer 12.5 weighted limit exists; generic transfer results already exist, so these specializations do not independently unblock the target.

summary: This implements Layer 13 while its roadmap prerequisite, Layer 12.5, remains absent from main and any cited open PR.
